blocks.title: Processing 2025 Impact Report
blocks.body: Our 2025 Impact Report marks a pivotal year of evolution for Processing Foundation, highlighting strategic program growth and deepening community engagement. Learn more about our software releases, educational initiatives, and our work building a more equitable and accessible creative coding ecosystem.
